_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: With 0% of 73 windows producing a ±2+ point move, this is a proven coil — HOLD is the skilled call until the breaker fires.
next_move.brains_agree: No — analyst calls LONG with low conviction while narrative implies directional recovery; both are constructive but the analyst's own track record undercuts the directional call, so the judge overrides to HOLD as the honest base rate.
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC funding drops below 0.005% while VIX holds above 18 and BTC breaks $67K with volume — suppressed leverage with macro fear translating to crypto bid.
next_move.invalidated_if: VIX collapses below 12 with DXY ripping above 102 and BTC funding spiking above 0.015% — kills the macro rotation thesis and traps longs in Denial range-extension.
